prompt: The group agrees to an item and assigns its owner and date, but a partner outside the meeting has yet to approve it. What should the recorder do?
promptZh: 與會者同意一項行動，已指派負責人及日期，但會議外的合作方尚未核准。記錄者要怎麼做？

options.text: Place it under Actions because the date was chosen
options.zh: 既然選了日期，就列為「行動」
options.whyZh: 有日期不會取消獨立的外部核准條件。

options.text: Put it under Ideas and remove its owner
options.whyZh: 事情已經同意執行，只欠外部核准；原文要保留負責人。

options.text: Put it under Waiting but delete all timing information
options.zh: 列為「等待中」，但刪除所有時程資訊
options.whyZh: 規則明確要保留暫訂日期，只需註明還不是正式日期。

options.text: Put it under Waiting and keep the date as provisional
options.zh: 列為「等待中」，保留日期並註明暫定
options.whyZh: 外部核准未到齊，即使有負責人也要列 Waiting；日期保留但加暫定標註。

explanationZh: 外部核准未到齊，即使有負責人也要列 Waiting；日期保留但加暫定標註。
evidence: If it does, put it under Waiting, even if an owner and a date have been assigned. / Keep both the owner and the penciled date in the notes, but mark the date as provisional.

vocabulary.note: 尚未確認，可能因核准或後續安排而改變。
